lastResponse.text: First step: call two one one right now. Say, “I’m in Beaverton, I have a pay-or-vacate notice, and I need eviction-prevention help for six hundred dollars this month.” Ask for the fastest referral from the Eviction Prevention Assistance providers and exactly what documents to gather before you make the next calls.
